Load data

df <- readRDS("./data/dataset/CA_LTACH_first_clinical_per_quarter_CRKP_genomes_merged_studies_metadata.RDS")   
df_201415 <- df%>% subset(study == "2014-15")
df_202123<- df%>% subset(study == "2021-23")

Complete case analysis

paste0("Number of isolates: ", nrow(df_202123)) 
[1] "Number of isolates: 507"
complete_case <- df_202123[df_202123 %>% select(resistance_vars %>% subset(!. %in% c("blbli_dich_num","FDC_dich_num"))) %>% is.na() %>% rowSums()  ==0  ,] 

paste0("Number of considered individuals with complete MIC resistance data for this analysis: ", nrow(complete_case ))
[1] "Number of considered individuals with complete MIC resistance data for this analysis: 506"

Supplemental figure: Correlation matrix of MIC values

MIC_variables_no_blbli_cef <- subset(MIC_variables,!MIC_variables %in% c('blbli',"FDC"))
MIC_correlation <-  cor(complete_case %>% select(paste0(MIC_variables_no_blbli_cef,"_log_2")) , method="spearman",use='pairwise.complete.obs') %>% round(.,2)
 
rownames(MIC_correlation) <-  rownames(MIC_correlation) %>% gsub("_log_2","_dich_num",.) %>% recode_resistance_variables()
colnames(MIC_correlation) <-  colnames(MIC_correlation) %>% gsub("_log_2","_dich_num",.) %>% recode_resistance_variables() 

MIC_correlation %>% kable()

corr_heatmap <- ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(MIC_correlation %>% as.matrix,border_color = "black",name ="Spearman's rank correlation coefficient",legend=F,fontsize = 12,
    row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(MIC_correlation), gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)),
    column_names_max_height = max_text_width(colnames(MIC_correlation), gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)),
    cluster_rows=T,cluster_cols = T,number_color = "black",breaks = c(-1,0,1),color=c("blue","white","red"),display_numbers = T)  

## Complex heatmap legend 
fig_legend <- Legend(at = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1),labels = c("-1.00", "-0.50", "0.00", "0.50", "1.00"),title = "Spearman's rank correlation coefficient",direction = "horizontal",col_fun = colorRamp2(breaks = c(-1,  0,  1),colors = c("blue","white","red")), title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14),labels_gp=gpar(fontsize=12),legend_width = unit(10, "cm"), title_position = 'topcenter')
 
# Print heatmap
fig_heatmap_image <- grid.grabExpr(draw(corr_heatmap))
fig_legend_image <- grid.grabExpr(draw(fig_legend))

corrfig <- plot_grid(fig_heatmap_image,fig_legend_image,ncol=1,axis="l", align="hv",rel_heights = c(1,.125))

Print figure

corrfig

Save figure

ggsave(plot = corrfig, filename = "./figures/s_figure_13_resistance_MIC_correlations.png", width = 7, height = 7, bg = "white", dpi=900)
